control_rules.text: Never specify FSSAI 09.xxx:2024 without full source PDF, title, unique procedure, applicable formal adoption and lab scope.
Previously suggested 09.001 AAS, 09.003 food ICP-AES and 09.005 lead ICP-MS cannot be selected from number alone.
Other-hosted 09.003 water ICP-MS, 09.004 food Pb ICP-MS and 09.005 nutritional Cr method are also not automatically approved without a precedence decision.
Sample fat/moisture, processing state and analyte measurement basis must match method and current legally applicable CTR food article.
No direct lot COAs or signed method/legal decisions available; all 533/498/35 counts remain.
